Optical Power Meter OTECH Mini Portable OPM VFL Network Cable Tester

The OTECH Mini Portable Optical Power Meter (OPM) VFL Network Cable Tester is an all-in-one fiber optic testing tool designed for FTTH, FTTB, and FTTX fiber optical networks. With its high-precision optical power measurement, visual fault locator (VFL), and RJ45 network cable testing capabilities, this device is perfect for fiber optic technicians, network engineers, and telecom professionals. This compact and lightweight tester features a calibrated wavelength range of 850/1300/1310/1490/1550/1625nm, ensuring accurate measurement across various fiber optic networks. The OPM measurement range of -50 to +26dBm provides reliable signal strength readings, while the 10mW Visual Fault Locator helps detect fiber faults, bends, and breaks over distances of up to 10km. One of the standout features of the OTECH Mini Portable OPM is its RJ45 network cable tester, making it a versatile tool for both fiber optic and Ethernet cable diagnostics. Whether you are working on fiber installation, maintenance, or troubleshooting, this device streamlines your workflow by combining multiple functionalities into a single, user-friendly unit. Powered by a rechargeable lithium battery, the OTECH Mini OPM ensures long-lasting performance for extended field use. Its SC adapter interface guarantees easy connectivity, while the handheld ergonomic design enhances portability and convenience. With low power consumption, high durability, and advanced testing capabilities, the OTECH Mini Portable OPM VFL Network Cable Tester is an essential tool for professionals in the fiber optic and networking industry. Whether you need to measure optical power, locate faults, or test network cables, this device delivers accuracy, efficiency, and reliability in one compact package.

Features of Optical Power Meter OTECH Mini Portable OPM VFL Network Cable Tester

  • Multi-Wavelength Calibration – Supports 850/1300/1310/1490/1550/1625nm for accurate fiber optic power measurements.
  • Wide OPM Measurement Range – Measures optical power levels from -50 to +26dBm, ensuring precise testing.
  • Built-in Visual Fault Locator (VFL) – 10mW laser source helps detect fiber faults, bends, and breaks up to 10km.
  • SC Adapter Interface – Ensures easy connectivity and compatibility with standard fiber optic connectors.
  • Optical Fiber Multimeter Functionality – Provides multiple testing functions in a single device.
  • RJ45 Network Cable Tester – Supports Ethernet cable testing for versatile network diagnostics.
  • Rechargeable Lithium Battery – Long-lasting battery life for extended field use.
  • Handheld & Portable Design – Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry for on-the-go professionals.
  • All-in-One Testing Tool – Ideal for FTTH, FTTB, and FTTX fiber optic networks.
  • User-Friendly Operation – Simple interface for quick and efficient testing.
